sections.name: 42083 - main.ldr
sections.description: Top-level assembly of the Bugatti Chiron, integrating chassis, drivetrain, gearbox, engine, and bodywork submodels into the complete model.

sections.name: 42083 - chassisrear.ldr
sections.description: Rear chassis frame built from long liftarms, open-center beams, and T-beams with extensive pin connectors forming the structural backbone.

sections.name: 42083 - rearaxle.ldr
sections.description: Rear axle assembly featuring a differential gear, cross blocks, and beams that transfer drive to the rear wheels.

sections.name: 42083 - rearwheelsupport.ldr
sections.description: Rear wheel support structure using bent liftarms, cross blocks, and axles to mount and position the rear wheels.

sections.name: 42083 - shock-06_5L-hard-1.ldr
sections.description: Hard 6.5L shock absorber unit with a cylinder and piston rod providing rear suspension damping.

sections.name: 42083 - shock-06_5L-hard-1_springMesh.ldr
sections.description: Procedurally generated spring mesh for the hard 6.5L shock absorber with 15 windings across 5 sections.

sections.name: 42083 - gearbox.ldr
sections.description: Main gearbox containing multiple 16-tooth and 20-tooth bevel gears, bent liftarms, and axles forming the gear-shifting mechanism.

sections.name: 42083 - gearbox2.ldr
sections.description: Secondary gearbox section with 8-tooth and 16-tooth gears, a clutch gear, and axles providing additional gear ratios.

sections.name: 42083 - rubberBandRound-1.ldr
sections.description: Round rubber band assembly modeled as 20 connected segments forming a loop for tension-based mechanisms.

sections.name: 42083 - engine.ldr
sections.description: V8 engine assembly with 8 cylinder heads, pistons, connecting rods, and two crankshafts mounted on a stud-and-peghole brick base.

sections.name: 42083 - enginelower.ldr
sections.description: Lower half of the engine with 4 cylinder heads, a crankshaft assembly, connecting rods, and pistons driving off a 24-tooth gear.

sections.name: 42083 - enginebeam.ldr
sections.description: Engine support beam framework using long liftarms, bent beams, and angle connectors to mount and brace the engine block.

sections.name: 42083 - chassisfront.ldr
sections.description: Front chassis frame constructed from many long liftarms, H-beams, bent beams, and driving ring joiners forming the main forward structure.

sections.name: 42083 - chassisfront2.ldr
sections.description: Supplementary front chassis section with open-center beams, bent liftarms, and a 24-tooth gear providing additional structural support.

sections.name: 42083 - chassisfront3.ldr
sections.description: Compact front chassis reinforcement using a long open-center beam, a beam 11, and perpendicular pin connectors for rigidity.

sections.name: 42083 - frontaxle.ldr
sections.description: Front axle assembly with universal joints, angle connectors, bent liftarms, and steering linkages for driven front wheels.

sections.name: 42083 - frontaxlediff.ldr
sections.description: Front axle differential unit with a 28-tooth bevel differential, 12-tooth bevel gears, and a 20-tooth bevel gear for drive distribution.

sections.name: 42083 - frontwheelsupport.ldr
sections.description: Front wheel hub assembly with a steering bearing, towball pins, brake disc hub, and suspension arm mounting the front wheel.

sections.name: 42083 - shock-06_5L-hard-2.ldr
sections.description: Second hard 6.5L shock absorber unit with cylinder and piston rod providing front suspension damping.

sections.name: 42083 - shock-06_5L-hard-2_springMesh.ldr
sections.description: Procedurally generated spring mesh for the second hard 6.5L shock absorber with 15 windings across 5 sections.

sections.name: 42083 - chassisfront4.ldr
sections.description: Front chassis sub-frame using bent liftarms, cross blocks, and beams to reinforce and connect the front axle area.

sections.name: 42083 - frontchassis5.ldr
sections.description: Small front chassis linkage with bent beams, a long axle, and pin connectors providing structural connection points.

sections.name: 42083 - chassisfront5.ldr
sections.description: Front chassis section with long axles, driving ring joiners, a 20-tooth bevel gear, and bent beams contributing to steering and drive routing.

sections.name: 42083 - stepper.ldr
sections.description: Stepper mechanism with a 24-tooth gear, 4-knob gear, wheel rim, triangle liftarms, and bushes forming a sequential gear selector.

sections.name: 42083 - rubberBandRound-2.ldr
sections.description: Second round rubber band assembly modeled as 31 connected segments forming a shorter tension loop.

sections.name: 42083 - rubberBandRound-3.ldr
sections.description: A flexible rubber band component modeled as a loop of 26 interconnected segments forming a closed round path.

sections.name: 42083 - chassisfront6.ldr
sections.description: A front chassis section built from an open-center Technic beam frame with gears, axles, and angled connectors for steering/drive linkages.

sections.name: 42083 - chassisfront7.ldr
sections.description: A front chassis subassembly combining bent liftarms, a cross block, and a reinforced 8-tooth gear for angled drivetrain connections.

sections.name: 42083 - chassisfront8.ldr
sections.description: A robust front chassis structure using paired long liftarms, cross blocks, and open-center beams joined by numerous friction pins.

sections.name: 42083 - bottom1.ldr
sections.description: A lower body section consisting of long beams, side panels, and an H-shaped beam linked with friction pins to form the underfloor frame.

sections.name: 42083 - bottomside1.ldr
sections.description: A lower side panel assembly combining a trapezium panel, a thin short fairing, and a cross block mounted on a beam 5.

sections.name: 42083 - bottom2.ldr
sections.description: A lower body section mirroring bottom1, built from long beams, side panels, and an H-shaped beam pinned together to form the underfloor frame.

sections.name: 42083 - bottomside2.ldr
sections.description: A lower side panel assembly mirroring bottomside1, with a trapezium panel, thin short fairing, and cross block mounted on a beam 5.

sections.name: 42083 - technicflexSysHose-1.ldr
sections.description: A long flexible Technic hose modeled as 66 segments forming an approx 119 mm routed path using ribbed hose subparts.

sections.name: 42083 - chiron.ldr

sections.name: 42083 - fairingmotortop2.ldr
